findings.evidence: Modulus.lean:556 holds the existing `Modulus.isCoprimeTo_iff`; VonMangoldt.lean:99 and :119 declare the new lemmas under `namespace TauCeti.LFunctions`.
findings.fix: Move both to `NumberField/Global/RayClass/Modulus.lean` (next to `Modulus.isCoprimeTo_iff`) as `Modulus.isCoprimeTo_asIdeal_iff` and `Modulus.isCoprimeTo_idealPrimePower_iff`, then update the uses in VonMangoldt.lean and Rat.lean.
findings.issue: `isCoprimeTo_asIdeal_iff` and `isCoprimeTo_idealPrimePower_iff` (line 119) mention only `Modulus`, `HeightOneSpectrum` and `IdealPrimePower` and have nothing to do with ray-class ψ. They are declared in `TauCeti.LFunctions`, so `𝔪.isCoprimeTo_asIdeal_iff` dot notation is unavailable.

findings.evidence: The `hcop_iff` body repeats `primePowerBase_pow_primePowerExponent`, `Ideal.isPrimeTo_pow_iff` and `Ideal.isPrimeTo_asIdeal_iff`, exactly the proof of VonMangoldt.lean:119-123.
findings.fix: After relocating `isCoprimeTo_idealPrimePower_iff`, use it here (through `Modulus.isCoprimeTo_iff`) instead of the local re-derivation.
findings.issue: `norm_vonMangoldtTransform_sub_induced_idealPrimePower` proves a local `hcop_iff` (prime power is prime to `𝔬.support` iff its base is outside the support). This duplicates `isCoprimeTo_idealPrimePower_iff` from the same PR.

findings.evidence: grep: Rat.lean:61 `private theorem subsingleton_rayClassGroup_one_rat`; SubgroupConductor/Rat.lean:124 `have : Subsingleton (RayClassGroup (ratModulus n hn))`.
findings.fix: Export it as a public `instance : Subsingleton (RayClassGroup (Modulus.one ℚ))` in `NumberField/Global/RayClass/Rat.lean` (or next to `card_rayClassGroup_ratModulus`), and reuse it at both sites.
findings.issue: `private theorem subsingleton_rayClassGroup_one_rat` states a general fact about `RayClassGroup (Modulus.one ℚ)` that has nothing to do with Chebyshev functions. It is hidden here, and `SubgroupConductor/Rat.lean:124` proves a similar `Subsingleton (RayClassGroup (ratModulus n hn))` inline again.

summary: Two general `Modulus` coprimality lemmas sit in the wrong namespace and file, and are duplicated in a local proof. A reusable subsingleton fact for `RayClassGroup (Modulus.one ℚ)` is hidden as `private` instead of being exported as an instance.
